message.content:
This is a flatbed trailer, not self-propelled, used for hauling freight. That places it in heading 8716, trailers and semi-trailers. Within 8716.39, "other trailers and semi-trailers for the transport of goods" covers it, and the 8716.39.00 subheading has statistical suffixes.

The suffixes under 8716.39.00 are:
- 8716.39.0030: Dump trailers
- 8716.39.0040: Trailers for agricultural use
- 8716.39.0090: Other (older versions had separate lines for flatbed and van trailers)

Older HTS versions listed 8716.39.0010 for "Logging trailers" and 8716.39.0050 for "Other: Of iron or steel". The current structure is:
- 8716.39.00: Other
- 8716.39.0010 Trailers for the transport of goods, of a type designed for carrying logs
- 8716.39.0030 Other, Dump trailers
- 8716.39.0040 Other, Flatbed or low-bed trailers
- 8716.39.0050 Other, Tanker
- 8716.39.0090 Other

A CBP ruling on a similar combo flatbed trailer is likely to have classified it under 8716.39.0090. However, I believe the "flatbed" line may sit within 8716.39.00 as 8716.39.0040. I am not certain of this, but the product is plainly a flatbed trailer, so I will choose 8716.39.0040.
